# Code Anchors: Conformance Gate

- `components/commands/nxs.analyze.md` — the gate's producer: the departure pass against a format-dependent baseline, the verdict published only on a pull request with its judgments block, the terminal-only run without one, the blocked-run-publishes-nothing rule, the epic-entry-only refusal, and the epic-level judgment on the completing pull request
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — reads the verdict before mining anything, stops on open critical or high items with no override, and never reads a local analysis file an older release left behind
- `components/commands/nxs.fix.md` — writes the literal state value a fix entry's record carries in place of a verdict, so the state stays greppable and can never read as a waiver
- `libs/pr-acceptance/src/verify.ts` — the receipt-block parser, which maps an absent writing release to an unknown writer and an absent stamped repository to a same-repository read, and now surfaces the stamped record reference and digest (#521)
- `libs/pr-acceptance/src/verify.spec.ts` — pins that a receipt carrying the newer stamped fields parses to the same values as one without them (#521)
- `libs/portable-tools/src/pipeline-stores.ts` — the exclusion set the gate's diff appends, having withheld nothing before
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/pr-verdict.ts` — the callable reader the gate now invokes for a pull request's verdict, in place of prose the gate carried out by hand (#753)
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the verb exposing that reader to the gate, refusing when the caller does not name the repository being read (#753)
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/publish-check.ts` — the boundary this gate's publish step must pass: a verdict naming no issues repository is refused rather than published (#765).
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/ledger.ts` — the record a merged run writes on the epic issue, and the key that makes a re-run replace one record rather than add a second (#778)
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/ledger.spec.ts` — pins that an open pull request writes no record and that a re-run leaves every other record untouched (#778)
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/epic-completion.ts` — whether a pull request completes its epic, whether its head contains every merged sibling, and where analyze addressed by epic number goes instead of combining verdicts
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/epic-completion.spec.ts` — pins the completing and non-completing cases, the not-run finding naming the update, and the failed claiming read that stops the run
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/close-ledger.ts` — the findings summed from the epic's records for the derivation close still calls, with the aggregate-mode range reader removed
- `libs/portable-tools/src/analyze-departures.spec.ts` — pins the departure pass: a broken guarantee as one departure, the superseding mark, and a stub shown beside the departure it explains
- `libs/portable-tools/src/analyze-local-terminal.spec.ts` — pins that analyze run without a pull request writes no file and that no other stage names the local analysis file
- `libs/portable-tools/src/analyze-epic-level.spec.ts` — pins that the success metrics are judged only on the completing pull request
- `libs/portable-tools/src/analyze-close-carry.spec.ts` — pins that the verdict carries the key decisions and deferred-scope proposals close writes into its record
- `libs/portable-tools/src/concept-invariants.ts` — lists each listed invariant at the base of the change and marks the ones a declared change covers (#903)
- `libs/portable-tools/src/analyze-concept-invariants.spec.ts` — pins the concept departure as an ordinary departure at severity high, with a stated report line (#903)
- `components/commands/nxs.analyze.md` — the concept-invariant pass and the report line for what was checked against the store (#903)
